title: Sharp continued-fraction bounds from exact digit runs
summary: Proves sharp bounds for both extrema of three consecutive ordinary continued-fraction approximation coefficients. Exact finite runs of every integer central digit at least two have rational four-corner constants, unique coordinate extremizers, strict actual inequalities, and optimality within the prescribed digit classes.
